name: register-company-south-africa
description: Register a private company (Pty Ltd) in South Africa via the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC).
requires_human_steps: Director identity verification (in-person at SAPS or via accredited verifier such as Lexis Refinitiv)
Signing of the Memorandum of Incorporation (MOI) by all directors
B-BBEE EME affidavit signature before a Commissioner of Oaths
